verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada is an online corporate registry. A buyer could reasonably ask whether it supports background automations such as scheduled or automatic filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual online and PDF filing channels, and the probe notes that the registry documents no transactional API. The automatic email notice sent when corporate changes are filed is a system notification, not a user-configurable autonomous automation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
